description: List the phases of ONE workflow's project plan, ordered by sort_order, with each phase's ID, title, status (pending/in_progress/done/blocked) and assigned agent. Use the phase IDs with update_phase_status to progress work. Phases always belong to a single workflow — never list or combine phases from several workflows. When the user asks for phases: if a workflow is loaded in this session, pass its workflowId. If no workflow is loaded, call this WITHOUT workflowId: it returns the workflows that have phases, so you can ask the user which one they want — then call again with that workflowId.

workflowId.description: Workflow ID — the loaded workflow, or the one the user picked. Omit only to get the list of workflows to choose from.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to your configured workspace.

name: list_phases
